parsed.change_summary: Added address range checks in the write and read functions to restrict access to known PPU register addresses.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger no longer works because the write and read functions now include checks to ensure that the address is within the valid range of PPU register addresses. If the address is out of bounds, the functions will not perform any operation, effectively blocking out-of-bounds read or write attempts.
